const int MOD = 1000000007;

int power(int a, int b) {
    long long ans = 1;
    while (b != 0) {
        ans = (ans * a) % MOD;
        --b;
    }
    return static_cast<int>(ans);
}

int main() {
    int p, k;
    std::cin >> p >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        std::cout << power(p, p - 1);
    } else if (k == 1) {
        std::cout << power(p, p);
    } else {
        int ord = 1;
        int cur = k;
        while (cur != 1) {
            cur = static_cast<int>(static_cast<long long>(cur) * k % p);
            ++ord;
        }
        std::cout << power(p, (p - 1) / ord);
    }
    return 0;
}
